question:
**Direction: In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.**

To bear the brunt of

options.text: To endure the impact of something

solution:
The correct answer is **"To endure the impact of something."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"To bear the brunt of"** means to experience the full force or impact of something negative. (किसी नकारात्मक चीज़ की पूरी ताकत या प्रभाव का अनुभव करना)
 
• The word **"brunt"** refers to the main force or shock of an attack or blow. (किसी हमले या प्रहार का मुख्य बल या आघात)
 
 
• **Example**: *During the pandemic, small businesses have had **to bear the brunt of**__ the economic downturn. *
 
 
 
• The correct answer is option 3.
